description:
Perform a moderation analysis to test if Exam Anxiety moderates the effect of Revision time on Exam performance. 

1. Open the dataset '/home/ga/Documents/JASP/ExamAnxiety.csv'.
2. Run a Linear Regression with 'Exam' as the Dependent Variable.
3. Add 'Revise' and 'Anxiety' as Covariates.
4. Create an interaction term between 'Revise' and 'Anxiety' and add it to the model.
5. Enable 'Simple Slopes' analysis (plot simple slopes with 'Revise' on x-axis and 'Anxiety' as moderator).
6. Save the results to '/home/ga/Documents/JASP/Moderation_Analysis.jasp'.
